name: Nexus
tagline: Crypto, themed bundles and fractional real estate in one app
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team (2022–23)

scenes.title: Crypto and real estate in one app
scenes.body: Digital assets, real-estate markets by country and one portfolio view, designed for iOS and Android.

scenes.title: An Explore tab built for browsing
scenes.body: Swipeable carousels surface trending bundles, real-estate markets by country and top gainers.

scenes.title: Every coin with its own sparkline
scenes.body: Price and daily change for each coin, with search in the header and a Watchlist tab.

scenes.title: Themed bundles in the app design
scenes.body: The design groups a theme like Metaverse into several coins under one chart and one Buy button.

scenes.title: Your whole portfolio on one screen
scenes.body: Balance and trend up top, 1D to ALL ranges, then cash, bundles and coins with Top up and Withdraw.
